answer: Screen newcomers like a desert mesa: every fresh agent lands on the mesa floor with zero privileges and earns standing only through observed, verifiable work. Random raven scouts fly unannounced audit challenges, and each correct, on-time response adds to the agent's plume of signed attestations. Privileges scale with that plume, so a sybil farm gains nothing: every clone starts on the mesa floor, and faking raven-verified labor costs more than the rewards it can reach.
